problem:
The absolute difference between the outcomes of one roll of two fair tetrahedral dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the absolute difference of the outcomes of one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |

activity_context.topic_title: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables

feedback.problem:
The sum of the outcomes of rolling two unfair tetrahedral dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ as shown in the table below. What is the expected value of one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{9}{64}$ | $\frac{9}{32}$ | $\frac{5}{64}$ | $\frac{1}{16}$ | $\frac{1}{16}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |
feedback.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5)+6\cdot f(6)+7\cdot f(7)+8\cdot f(8) \\  & =2(\frac{1}{4})+3(\frac{1}{8})+4(\frac{9}{64})+5(\frac{9}{32})+6(\frac{5}{64})+7(\frac{1}{16})+8(\frac{1}{16}) \\  & =\frac{2}{4}+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{36}{64}+\frac{45}{32}+\frac{30}{64}+\frac{7}{16}+\frac{8}{16} \\  & =\frac{32+24+36+90+30+28+32}{64} \\  & =\frac{272}{64} \\  & =\frac{17}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
